text: In HoTT, a retraction of A onto B (r:A→B, s:B→A, r∘s~id_B) does NOT generally imply:
choices: B is a retract of A
The fibres of r are non-empty
s is injective up to homotopy
explanation: Retraction doesn't imply equivalence in general (only if it's also a section, i.e. a deformation retraction).
